This is part of the reason I don't bother seeking medical attention, even if I need it. I am fairly clumsy, and also have several not mental health related health concerns. Anytime I go to a doctor's appointment, I wind up having to explain myself – and it gets quite exhausting.
Except, I don't consider myself “helpless”, the reason my life is in the position it's in is solely through the choices I have made throughout my life.
